summary: Bank of Montreal filed a Form 6-K on October 20, 2026, carrying a press release announcing senior executive appointments rather than any transaction. Tim Cox, U.S. General Counsel since 2022, becomes U.S. Country Head and CEO of BMO Financial Corp. and BMO Bank N.A. effective November 1, 2026, reporting to CEO Darryl White and chairing the U.S. Management Committee. Darrel Hackett retires as U.S. CEO after 22 years, moving to Executive Vice-Chair and Senior Advisor effective the same date. This is a planned, orderly succession disclosure with no deal terms, advisors, or arbitrage angle.
